text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-san, Ikuno-san, Rob Roy-san, 
Messiah-san, Journey-san, Tran-san... Yes, 
the glasses character scene is truly a 
battle of rivals right now!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
When dealing with such strongly particular 
individuals, adopting things vaguely won't 
cut it. Unless you hone your own 
individuality again, you'll just get 
completely overshadowed!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What would be good? Something expensive? 
Something flashy? No, that would ruin the 
image of the sweet, devoted, beloved 
Royce-chan...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What matters is a natural, subtle sense of 
style. Like a hand-carved wooden frame, or 
perhaps even stone materials—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! You should just grow a tree 
from a sapling yourself and make the frame 
out of that!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate dedication with time and 
effort poured in...! Fufu, the title of 
Number 1 Glasses is mine!
